jobs.title: Material Planning Manager
jobs.description_text: About the Team The Material Planning team plays a critical role in ensuring Lucid’s manufacturing operations have the parts and materials needed to support serial production. This team partners closely with Purchasing, Logistics, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, and a global supplier network to protect production continuity and improve supplier delivery performance. What makes this team unique is its direct connection to daily production execution, long-term supply readiness, and cross-functional decision-making across more than 200 Tier 1 suppliers and thousands of parts and components. About the Role Lucid is seeking a Manager, Material Planning to lead the Material Planning team based at Lucid’s manufacturing facility in Phoenix, AZ. This role reports to a senior supply chain or materials leadership manager and exists to ensure production build requirements are supported through strong material availability, supplier execution, and MRP discipline. The Manager will close gaps in supplier performance, material readiness, inventory accuracy, and cross-functional escalation management as Lucid continues to scale production. In the first 12 months, this leader will own improvements in On-Time, In-Full performance, supplier delivery metrics, team operating standards, and communication routines that give the business clear visibility to material risk. jobs.title: Mobile Service Technician, Costa Mesa
jobs.description_text: The Mobile Service Technician is a unique position that covers field service repairs. This position would be responsible for traveling to client locations and will be responsible for diagnosing, maintaining and repairing Lucid Motors vehicles in the field. Lucid provides Mobile Service Technicians with a service van or truck and provides the needed tools. This fixed operation position will work independently as well as a team where you will have the support of the closet service location. You will demonstrate your passion for sustainable transportation and creatively solve problems in a fast-paced environment. As a Mobile Service Technician, it is expected to have ASE certifications obtained within 6-8 months of hire date. Lucid will reimburse the cost associated with successful completion. jobs.title: Order Operations Specialist
jobs.description_text: About the Team The European Order Operations team owns the end-to-end quote-to-cash transaction process and serves as the main operational partner for Retail and Corporate Sales teams on order-related matters. The team connects Sales, Delivery, Logistics, Service, Production Control, IT, Finance, Tax, and Accounting to maintain accurate orders and enable timely deliveries. It combines hands-on daily execution with structured performance management, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. The team’s impact is visible in orderbook accuracy, delivery readiness, revenue recognition support, and a reliable experience for internal and external stakeholders. About the Role The Order Operations Specialist is an individual contributor role reporting to the Supervisor, Order Operations and supporting the execution of Lucid’s European order-to-delivery operations. This role ensure s that customers and vehicle orders move accurately and efficiently through the transaction lifecycle, while providing Sales and Delivery teams with reliable operational support. Y ou will take ownership of day-to-day order execution, proactively resolve transactional issues, maintain accurate data across systems, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure that vehicles, invoices, payments, and customer documentation are ready for delivery. Success will be demonstrated through accurate orderbook data, timely issue resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and improved operational consistency.

This position requires the ability to handle a rapidly changing workload and can prioritize accordingly. This is an excellent opportunity to gain experience, learn, and develop your career within the automotive industry. Responsibilities: Provides a world-class customer experience to all Lucid clients, both internal and external Vehicle drives include dropping off or picking up customer vehicles and/or loaners, runs to the Bodyshop, test charging at EA (Electrify America) charge stations, among others. Arranging Lyft rides for internal vehicle moves per request Assist with Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) carrier preparation and vehicle hand-over. When needed, help with check in process Assist technicians with basic repairs in the shop Other duties as assigned including but not limited to moving and staging vehicles, delivering parts, washing vehicles, and assisting the service department as needed Qualifications: 18 years of age or older Basic automotive knowledge At Lucid, we don’t just welcome diversity - we celebrate it! INDFS Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan.

jobs.title: Service Concierge, Costa Mesa
jobs.description_text: The Service Concierge position directly interfaces with service center clients as an integral part of the customer experience. This position is responsible for varied duties in the service center such as greeting clients, answering phones, directing client inquiries, and scheduling appointments. This is an excellent opportunity to gain experience, learn, and develop your career within the automotive industry. The Role: Provides a world-class customer experience to all Lucid clients, both internal and external Coordinate and schedule client appointments determined by service center capacity, turnaround time, and priority levels Manage open service tasks and due bills, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution Proactively contact customers to verify their concerns, schedule appointments, and meticulously log all activities in the system to maintain accurate records Manage and facilitate loaner agreements, coordinating rental vehicle requests for customers as needed, including arranging Lyft rides for customer convenience Generate Work Order Pre-writes in the system, capturing customer concerns and obtaining the necessary signatures for pre-authorization. It is essential to check for any open campaigns or recalls that may need to be addressed Assist Service Advisors during vehicle check-in by conducting thorough walkthroughs, completing intake forms, taking photographs, and reporting any damages found Consistent with customer communication regarding follow up calls, responsivenes

jobs.title: Sr. Product Designer
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Product Designer , you will own the design of key product areas across Lucid's connected vehicle ecosystem, shaping how people interact with their vehicle every day, both in the car and on their phone. We are looking for a talented product designer with strong craft, product thinking, and attention to detail. Automotive experience is not required. What matters most is your ability to solve complex problems, design intuitive and elegant experiences, and deliver high-quality work from concept through launch. You will work closely with design leadership, product managers, UX researchers, and software and hardware engineers to bring cohesive, refined experiences to life. Why Lucid We believe the future of luxury is defined by experience. The best products do not just look premium. They feel seamless, intuitive, and thoughtfully designed at every touchpoint. That is the standard we hold ourselves to. If you care about the kind of craft that makes complex technology feel effortless and human, this is the team for you. As a designer here, you will work on products people interact with every day, solving complex problems across software, hardware, and connected services. The team is small, the problems are real, and the bar for craft is high. If you want your work to define what a modern ownership experience feels like, this is the place. Want a sense of the kind of experiences we’re creating? Watch The Studio: Experience Driven | The Road To Lucid Gravity

We focus on manipulation, humanoid and whole-body control, large-scale simulated training, sim-to-real transfer, robot foundation models and skill learning. Seasonal Sales Associates are responsible for outstanding customer service and demonstrating superior knowledge to customers during periods of high volume. This role supports team members and stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones while serving as a key onsite resource for the local office. Working in partnership with the Sr. Manager overseeing the site, the Administrative Coordinator will support day-to-day onsite operations, serve as an onsite point of contact, and help identify, coordinate, and escalate office needs as appropriate. This is a highly collaborative and hands-on role with responsibilities spanning global team coordination, onsite operations, meetings, workshops, events, and administrative support. The ideal candidate is an experienced administrative professional who is comfortable navigating a fast-paced, global environment, managing multiple priorities, and partnering effectively across teams and functions. While this position will not be dedicated to supporting an individual executive, experience with executive-level support is highly valued. The Administrative Coordinator should be comfortable providing backup executive support when needed.
